direct_claims: This chart shows the share of population living in multidimensional poverty across various countries.
The data is based on the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2025 by Alkire et al.
The chart is produced by Our World in Data.
Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education, and living standards indicators.
The data is based on the most recent household survey data between 2013 and 2023.
A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends over time.
The chart uses a color-coded map to represent the share of population living in multidimensional poverty, making it easier to visualize the data.
The data is not available for all countries.
